searchText: (Looks like I mixed up on the channel and posted it to the <#746566142700814426> instead of this channel). Reposting here to continue the thread in the correct channel. Following up on the breakout room for EVM 384 & BLS discussion. my understanding from the ACD meeting is that we want to get answers to a few open questions: - Clients’ general thoughts on EVM 384 & BLS12-381 & BLS12-377 curves - Readiness on individual proposals - Document concerns on (a) the performance difference (b) Implementation/upgrade readiness - Thoughts on monthly discussion on EVM 384, & BLS curve progress (frequency/week day/ time). The process of inclusion is a “process” topic that could be brainstormed in the EIPIP meetings first and then will bring to the core devs/breakout room meeting discussion. Thoughts on the call date/time for the first breakout room (EVM384 - BLS 12-381 & BLS12-377 curves) meeting? Friday, Jan 15 at 1600 UTC Monday, Jan 18 at 1600 UTC Other suggestions on date/time? cc: <@!381789485777682434> <@!425279588009246720> <@!619357961923330051> <@!682078300234973185> @M H Swende (holiman) <@456226577798135808> <@!552133098075193354> <@!414247794375655424> @James Hancock (madeoftin) (Feel free to add more people interested in this meeting) Both time options are fine for me Friday is slightly preferable Both work for me 👍
